fire: The sign on the shop door said simply: GOODBYE AND THANKS.
Fans held up a banner reading GRIT BEATS TALENT at the match.
Her text message was just one word in capitals: GUILTY.
The old poster promised GIANT SAVINGS ON EVERY ITEM.
Headline in the morning paper: GLACIER RETREAT SPEEDS UP.
The error box on screen said GATEWAY TIMEOUT again.
He scrawled GRATEFUL across the top of the card.
